newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Imperial USD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Imperial USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
General Obligation Bonds, 1995 Election, Series B

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Supervisors of the County of Imperial, State of California, invites bids on $2,000,000 principal amount of Imperial Unified School District General Obligation Bonds, 1995 Election, Series B. Bids will be received on Wednesday, March 12, 1997

at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Andrew Ach &Associates, Inc., One Post Street, suite 2525, San Francisco, CA 94104, phone (415) 546-6460, or by facsimile at (415) 546-7875, and the sale will be awarded by the Imperial County

Administrative Officer or his designee on behalf of the Board of Supervisors of the County of Imperial within twenty-six (26) hours after the bid opening is completed. In the event that the Imperial County Administrative Officer or his authorized designee does not award a bid on the date specified above, proposals will be received on each Wednesday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded, at the same time and location. Further information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at the above address.
Legal Opinion: Bowie, Arneson, Kadi, Wiles & Giannone,
